headword: {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}

definitions.explanation: A formal document presented to praise an achievement or long service, typically read aloud at a ceremony before being handed over. Common in schools, workplaces, and local government.

examples.japanese: {校長|こうちょう}から{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a certificate of commendation from the principal.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}では{市長|しちょう}が{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: At the ceremony, the mayor read the certificate of commendation aloud.

examples.japanese: {三十年|さんじゅうねん}{勤|つと}めた{父|ちち}は、{会社|かいしゃ}から{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}と{記念品|きねんひん}を{贈|おく}られた。
examples.english: My father, who worked there for thirty years, was presented with a certificate of commendation and a memento by the company.

notes:
{表彰|ひょうしょう} (public commendation) + {状|じょう} (written document).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}を{贈|おく}る: to present a certificate
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}を{授与|じゅよ}する: to confer a certificate (formal)
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる: to read the certificate aloud

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {賞状|しょうじょう}: award certificate — for winning a contest or placing in a competition
- {感謝状|かんしゃじょう}: certificate of appreciation — thanks for help or cooperation, not merit
- {修了証|しゅうりょうしょう}: certificate of completion — records finishing a course
